project: Startups as a Band: Smells Like Team Spirit
notes: Hero A (shapes) is the post hero; Hero B is the shapes alternate. Poster A/B are earlier gig-poster directions, kept as alternates.

artwork.prompt: Wide 16:9 presentation slide, plain white background, clean 1990s PowerPoint/Visio aesthetic. At the top, large black Helvetica capitals: 'STARTUPS AS A BAND'. Directly below, a smaller black Helvetica line: 'SMELLS LIKE TEAM SPIRIT'. Across the lower half, four simple flat gray geometric shapes in a row, each with a thin black outline and a subtle drop shadow: a circle, a wide rectangle, a triangle, and a square. Below each shape, a small black label: 'SOLO', 'DUO', 'TRIO', 'QUARTET'. Bottom edge, tiny black Helvetica: 'THE ELEVEN SOCIETY SUMMIT'. No gradients, no 3D, no photos. Simple flat shaded shapes like clip art. Render all quoted text exactly, correctly spelled and legible. No real logos, no signatures.

Wide 16:9 social share card, stark black-and-white, 1980s independent gig poster. Off-white paper background. Left two-thirds: three stacked lines of enormous black ultra-condensed grotesque capitals, tightly leaded: 'STARTUPS', 'AS A', 'BAND'. Directly below, one line of smaller heavy black condensed capitals: 'SMELLS LIKE TEAM SPIRIT'. Right third: four simple black silhouettes of a four-piece band — singer, guitar, bass, drums — standing in a row like a lineup. Bottom left, small black Helvetica: 'THE ELEVEN SOCIETY SUMMIT'. Bottom right, small black 'PWV'. Photocopy grain, halftone dots, worn paper edges. Severe, minimal, high contrast, readable at small sizes. Render all quoted text exactly, correctly spelled and legible. No real logos, no signatures.
